Precise appearance controls

Actual settings and financial cards at slider values 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100. All three controls are set to the labelled value; new defaults are 80 roundness, 30 border thickness, and 50 shadow effect. Existing saved numerical preferences are preserved.

Limits: Chromium in this environment only. Physical devices, Safari/Firefox, and live Cloudflare deployment were not tested. Direct file URLs are blocked by the managed browser; standalone HTML was tested over local HTTP with no external requests.
